manaNeeded: {4}{B}{B}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
notablePrerequisites: You have at least ten Spirit creature cards in your library.
description:
Cast Tainted Strike by paying {B}, giving Syr Konrad +1/+0 and infect until end of turn.
Cast Iname from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{B}{B} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Iname enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to search your library for at least ten Spirit creature cards and put them into your graveyard.
Syr Konrad triggers for each creature card that was put into your graveyard this way, giving each opponent that many poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.
